inference_tokens_managed_identity_active.name: inference_tokens_managed_identity_active_unique
inference_tokens_managed_identity_active.where: "inference_tokens"."revoked_at" is null and "inference_tokens"."managed_by" is not null

inference_limit_subject_valid.name: inference_limit_subject_valid
inference_limit_subject_valid.value: ("inference_limit_policies"."policy_type" = 'default' AND "inference_limit_policies"."user_id" IS NULL) OR ("inference_limit_policies"."policy_type" = 'user' AND "inference_limit_policies"."user_id" IS NOT NULL)

inference_model_access_subject_valid.name: inference_model_access_subject_valid
inference_model_access_subject_valid.value: ("inference_model_access_rules"."subject_type" = 'group' AND "inference_model_access_rules"."group_id" IS NOT NULL AND "inference_model_access_rules"."user_id" IS NULL) OR ("inference_model_access_rules"."subject_type" = 'user' AND "inference_model_access_rules"."user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "inference_model_access_rules"."group_id" IS NULL)

inference_models_token_limits_valid.name: inference_models_token_limits_valid
inference_models_token_limits_valid.value: "inference_models"."max_input_tokens" > 0 AND ("inference_models"."max_output_tokens" IS NULL OR "inference_models"."max_output_tokens" > 0) AND "inference_models"."auto_compact_token_limit" > 0 AND "inference_models"."auto_compact_token_limit" <= "inference_models"."max_input_tokens"
